replicate_statements: Representative ex vivo images of lungs from SNL mice, control (no Cre) or infected with Ad-Cre (11 months post infection), 24 h post injection with PDBA ICG 5.3 ultra pH-sensitive (UPS) nanoparticle.
control n = 5 mice; Ad-Cre n = 3 mice, biological replicates (Panel B, same imaging experiment)
outputs.replicate_type: biological replicates (mice); n stated in linked panel B for the same imaged mice
outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative images described as 'representative,' implying replication. The exact n (control n=5, Ad-Cre n=3, biological replicates) for this same imaging experiment is given in the immediately adjacent panel B, which quantifies these same images, so the replicate number and type are effectively reported for this dataset.

replicate_statements: Quantification of mean ICG fluorescence intensity (control n = 5 mice; Ad-Cre n = 3 mice, biological replicates).
outputs.explanation: The caption explicitly states the number of mice per group (n=5 control, n=3 Ad-Cre) and identifies them as biological replicates.

replicate_statements: H&E image of the lung section from Fig. 3A), with ICG signal on the same section, and RNAscope of Tmprss11b (red) on a serial section.
spatial plots depicting enrichment of Cd68 (macrophage marker) and Spp1 (immunosuppressive macrophage marker) transcripts in these regions.
outputs.explanation: Panel C shows histology, RNAscope, and spatial transcriptomics images from a single lung section (referenced from Fig. 3A) without stating how many sections, mice, or replicates this analysis is based on or representative of, so replicate number and type are not reported in this caption.

replicate_statements: Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) of immune cell pathways from the low pH versus high pH spatial transcriptomics data with normalized enrichment scores (NES), false discovery rate (FDR) and p values...
statistical significance was determined by bootstrapping with 1000 permutations.
outputs.explanation: The caption describes the statistical resampling method (1000 permutations) used for the GSEA test, but does not state how many biological samples, sections, or mice contributed the underlying low pH/high pH spatial transcriptomics data being compared, so the number and type of biological/technical replicates behind this analysis are not reported.

replicate_statements: Bar graph representing top M2-like/TAM genes from the differential gene expression (DEG) analysis of low pH versus high pH spatial transcriptomics data.
Differential gene expression was calculated using Seurat's FindAllMarkers function... Wilcoxon rank-sum test with Bonferroni P value correction.
outputs.explanation: The caption describes the statistical test used for differential expression but does not report the number of sections, mice, or spots (biological/technical replicates) underlying the low pH vs high pH comparison.

replicate_statements: The staining was repeated with lung sections from different mice (n = 2, biological replicates).
outputs.explanation: The caption explicitly states that staining was repeated in lung sections from n = 2 different mice, identified as biological replicates.
